Hariyali Teej Festival Approaches with Date and Ritual Information

Information regarding the observance of Hariyali Teej in 2026 is being disseminated across various Hindi media outlets. Several publications are focusing on the specific date of the festival, with some indicating August 14th and others August 15th, and providing details on auspicious timings for worship. Additionally, content includes guidance on fasting rituals, the significance of the festival, and tips for women on enhancing their appearance and strengthening marital relationships during this time.
